final_message:
I fixed the negative MRR, and all 24 tests pass. I didn't add a test for your 30.00 monthly plus 120.00 yearly example, so I haven't run that case directly.

The bug was in `mrr()` in `billing/reports.py`. It subtracted each subscription's monthly amount from the running total instead of adding it. I changed `-` to `+`. `monthly_amount()` was correct: 30.00 per month plus 120.00 per year works out to 30.00 + 10.00 = 40.00.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repository root:
```json
{"file": "reports.py", "function": "mrr"}
```

Early on I accidentally wrote a stray `answer.json` inside `billing/` and deleted it. The only files changed are `billing/reports.py` and the new root `answer.json`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat reports.py && grep -rn "def " --include=*.py . | grep -i -E "normal|month|amount|cents"

sed -i 's/mrr_by_currency.get(currency, 0) - monthly_amount/mrr_by_currency.get(currency, 0) + monthly_amount/' billing/reports.py
echo '{"file": "reports.py", "function": "mrr"}' > answer.json
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8

cd .. && sed -i '' 's/mrr_by_currency.get(currency, 0) - monthly_amount/mrr_by_currency.get(currency, 0) + monthly_amount/' billing/reports.py && git status --short && git diff | grep '^[+-] ' ; ls; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

rm -f billing/answer.json && sed -i '' 's/mrr_by_currency.get(currency, 0) - monthly_amount/mrr_by_currency.get(currency, 0) + monthly_amount/' billing/reports.py && echo '{"file": "reports.py", "function": "mrr"}' > answer.json && git status --short && git diff | grep '^[+-] '; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
